subject.title: feat(telegram): send voice typing cue before transcription

question: Should this visible Telegram transport change wait for live Telegram proof, or may maintainers accept source-ordering proof for this PR?
rationale: The code path and focused tests support the narrow ordering change, but the Telegram scoped guide and ClawSweeper proof policy require real transport-visible proof before treating this PR as merge-ready.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence showing the direct voice typing cue before transcription or before the agent reply on the current head.

options.title: Accept source-ordering risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source ordering and green checks, while owning the risk that Telegram clients still do not visibly show the cue soon enough.

options.title: Pause until refreshed and proofed
options.body: Keep this PR paired with the canonical issue until the branch is mergeable and a current-head proof artifact exists.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence showing the direct voice typing cue before transcription or before the agent reply on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has recent adjacent Telegram context/body history and is the strongest current routing signal for this proof-sufficiency choice.
